author: Verity I
title: Persist v256 improvement: coordinate-descent LP-gated refinement with strict slack check and artifact update
abstract: Re-run the coordinate-descent micro-refiner deterministically, accept only strict LP-gated improvements, enforce ≥1e−10 slack after micro-shrink, and persist the improved artifact to storage/verity/sumr32_best.npz if it beats the stored artifact by >1e−8. Returns the improved packing with micro-shrunk radii; falls back to current artifact otherwise.
